column1: # tools/test/affected.tsv -- which tests a changed file reaches.
#   glob    a path from the repository root, matched with File.fnmatch
#           (FNM_PATHNAME and FNM_EXTGLOB: `*` stays in one directory, `**/`
#           crosses them; a trailing `/**` is everything under the directory,
#           at any depth). THE FIRST ROW THAT MATCHES APPLIES, so a specific
#           row comes before the general one it narrows
#   tests   ids of tools/test/tests.tsv, comma-separated, or `@core-src`: the
#           file is CORE source, and affected.rb finds the definitions the
#           change touches and the entries that reach them
#   reason  why a change here reaches those tests
# A changed file no row matches is UNMAPPED: affected.rb lists it and exits 1,
# so a file this table does not know is never read as needing no test.
# vendor/spinel's row selects every suite but the export tool's two, because
# the pin is the compiler under all of them; a vendor change stays the owner's.
